source.model: ElevenLabs Sound Effects model selected by the service
source.prompt: Short close mechanical sound of four vectored-thrust jet nozzles rotating together under engine load. Heavy hydraulic actuator movement, precise metal linkage, restrained mechanical lock and a brief natural change in exhaust resonance as the nozzle angle changes. Approximately 1.2 seconds with a clean editable tail. No speech, warning beep, explosion, landing gear, exaggerated machinery or cinematic bass hit.

candidates.selectionReason: Best combination of useful level and peak headroom without reaching digital full scale.

runtime.processing: Candidate 03; tempo-adjusted to retain the complete action in 1.2 seconds; converted to centred mono 22.05 kHz 16-bit PCM; 12 ms fade-in, 90 ms fade-out and 2 dB attenuation. Reproducible with scripts/prepare-nozzle-transition-audio.ps1.
